Qatar's Emir Outlines National Strategies for Economic Diversification

Qatar's Emir delivered a national address outlining strategies to strengthen the country and adapt to global changes. He stated that Qatar has overcome the consequences of "exceptional events" and will emerge stronger by diversifying its economy and focusing on non-carbon industries.
